variants.text: A market town with a keep, both of them standing on a mound that everybody is careful not to call a grave.
Barrowgate. Gritstone, slate, and a great deal of wall.
The mound is in the middle of the town and the town has grown round it rather than over it, except for the keep, which did not.
Peat smoke, wool, and a wind that comes across eleven miles of heather to get here.
